name: Microsoft Teams
description: Talk to her in Microsoft Teams: her personal chat, and the channels and group chats you choose when someone mentions her.
author: The Sara team

settings.label: App ID
settings.tip: The Microsoft App ID of your Azure Bot (Configuration page). It looks like 8-4-4-4-12 letters and digits.

settings.label: Directory (tenant) ID
settings.tip: Your Microsoft 365 directory: Azure Bot → Configuration → App Tenant ID. Leave empty only for an older multi-tenant bot.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.tip: The Value of a client secret (Manage Password → Certificates & secrets), not its Secret ID. Kept encrypted in Sara's vault and never shown again.

settings.label: Send reminders and messages she starts to my Teams chat too
settings.tip: Her reminders also come to your personal chat with her in Teams. Never to channels or other people.

es.Talk to her in Microsoft Teams: her pers: Habla con ella en Microsoft Teams: su chat personal y, cuando alguien la menciona, los canales y chats de grupo que elijas.
es.The Microsoft App ID of your Azure Bot (: El Microsoft App ID de tu Azure Bot (página Configuration). Tiene la forma 8-4-4-4-12 letras y cifras.
es.Your Microsoft 365 directory: Azure Bot: Tu directorio de Microsoft 365: Azure Bot → Configuration → App Tenant ID. Déjalo vacío solo para un bot multiinquilino antiguo.
es.The Value of a client secret (Manage Pas: El Value de un secreto de cliente (Manage Password → Certificates & secrets), no su Secret ID. Se guarda cifrado en la bóveda de Sara y no se vuelve a mostrar.
es.Send reminders and messages she starts t: Enviar también a mi chat de Teams los recordatorios y mensajes que ella inicia
es.Her reminders also come to your personal: Sus recordatorios también llegan a tu chat personal con ella en Teams. Nunca a canales ni a otras personas.
